reference: Git's documented index behavior: git update-index --index-info creates and updates entries, git ls-files --stage lists them, and git update-index --add/--force-remove/--refresh provide the operation counterparts. The metadata contract uses Bash type/help builtins and the documented index help text.
coverage: Bash builtin availability and help metadata
write: canonical modes, sorting, conflict stages, and whitespace in names
read/list and -V array output against git ls-files --stage
text --index-info: mode-zero removal, conflict-stage replacement, and addition
NUL --index-info: NUL-delimited records and a newline in a path
Independent v2 reader input and exact per-side stat/checksum/cleanup validation, including fields that vary between namespaces.
exclusions: Atomic write, short-write, fdatasync, close, and rename failure rollback is deferred because it requires an independently reviewed syscall fault-injection mock.
Split and sparse index expansion, version 4, optional extensions, corrupt-index refusal, and unusual path compatibility are outside this compact suite.

cases.purpose: Bash must register index as a builtin and expose its documented help, including the atomic-write and update-stat verbs.
cases.script:
kind=$(type -t index)
[[ $kind == builtin ]] || exit 1
doc=$(help index)
[[ -n $doc && $doc == *"Atomic write"* && $doc == *"update-stat"* ]]
printf '%s\n' "$kind"

cases.purpose: Write an unsorted set of regular, executable, symlink, and conflict-stage records. The shared relative repository skeleton keeps the complete generated index files comparable byte for byte.
Check read output, the list synonym, and -V array contents against Git's staged listing for entries in path and stage order.
cases.script:
mkdir -p .git/objects .git/refs/heads .git/info
printf 'ref: refs/heads/main\n' > .git/HEAD
printf '[core]\n\trepositoryformatversion = 0\n\tfilemode = true\n\tbare = false\n' > .git/config
printf '100644 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111 0\talpha\n100644 2222222222222222222222222222222222222222 2\tmerge\n100644 3333333333333333333333333333333333333333 1\tmerge\n100755 4444444444444444444444444444444444444444 0\trun\n' > entries
if [[ $(type -t index) == builtin ]]; then
  index write .git/index < entries
  index read .git/index
  index list .git/index
  index read .git/index -V rows
  printf '%s\n' "${rows[@]}"
else
  git update-index --index-info < entries
  git ls-files --stage | while IFS= read -r line; do printf '%s\n' "${line/$'\t'/ }"; done
  git ls-files --stage | while IFS= read -r line; do printf '%s\n' "${line/$'\t'/ }"; done
  git ls-files --stage | while IFS= read -r line; do printf '%s\n' "${line/$'\t'/ }"; done
fi

cases.purpose: Apply textual index-info records that remove a path, add a conflict stage, replace all conflict stages with stage zero, and add another path; compare both the listing and resulting index file.
Exercise -z record framing and preserve an embedded newline in a path. The index files must match Git's update-index result exactly.
cases.script:
mkdir -p .git/objects .git/refs/heads .git/info
printf 'ref: refs/heads/main\n' > .git/HEAD
printf '[core]\n\trepositoryformatversion = 0\n\tfilemode = true\n\tbare = false\n' > .git/config
if [[ $(type -t index) == builtin ]]; then
  printf '100644 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111 0\tkeep\n100644 2222222222222222222222222222222222222222 0\tremove\n' | index write .git/index
  printf '0 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000\tremove\0' | index --index-info -z .git/index
  printf '100644 3333333333333333333333333333333333333333\tline\nbreak\0' | index --index-info -z .git/index
else
  git update-index --index-info <<'INITIAL'
100644 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111	keep
100644 2222222222222222222222222222222222222222	remove
INITIAL
  printf '0 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000\tremove\0' | git update-index -z --index-info
  printf '100644 3333333333333333333333333333333333333333\tline\nbreak\0' | git update-index -z --index-info
fi

cases.purpose: Add an empty working file from its known Git blob ID, list it, remove it, and list again. compare_tree is disabled because Git stores the empty blob object and both indexes record sandbox-specific inode and timestamp fields while the builtin receives the blob ID from its caller. Before removal, an independent Python decoder verifies all stored stat fields, object ID, checksum and lock/temp cleanup against the private working file on both sides.
cases.script:
mkdir -p .git/objects .git/refs/heads .git/info
printf 'ref: refs/heads/main\n' > .git/HEAD
printf '[core]\n\trepositoryformatversion = 0\n\tfilemode = true\n\tbare = false\n' > .git/config
: > fresh
if [[ $(type -t index) == builtin ]]; then
  index add .git/index e69de29bb2d1d6434b8b29ae775ad8c2e48c5391 fresh
  PATH=/usr/bin:/bin python3 - <<'STATCHECK'
import pathlib,struct,os,hashlib
p=pathlib.Path('.git/index');data=p.read_bytes()
assert data[:4]==b'DIRC'
version,count=struct.unpack_from('>II',data,4)
assert version in (2,3) and count==1
assert hashlib.sha1(data[:-20]).digest()==data[-20:]
fields=struct.unpack_from('>10I',data,12)
st=os.stat('fresh')
wanted=(st.st_ctime_ns//10**9,st.st_ctime_ns%10**9,st.st_mtime_ns//10**9,st.st_mtime_ns%10**9,st.st_dev,st.st_ino,0o100644,st.st_uid,st.st_gid,st.st_size)
wanted=tuple(v&0xffffffff for v in wanted)
assert fields==wanted,(fields,wanted)
assert data[52:72].hex()=='e69de29bb2d1d6434b8b29ae775ad8c2e48c5391'
flags=struct.unpack_from('>H',data,72)[0]
assert flags==5 and data[74:80]==b'fresh\0'
assert st.st_size==0 and not pathlib.Path('.git/index.lock').exists()
assert sorted(x.name for x in pathlib.Path('.git').iterdir())==['HEAD','config','index','info','objects','refs']
print('index-stat-fields-and-checksum-verified')
STATCHECK
  printf 'after-add\n'
  index read .git/index
  index remove .git/index fresh
  printf 'after-remove\n'
  index read .git/index
else
  git update-index --add -- fresh
  PATH=/usr/bin:/bin python3 - <<'STATCHECK'
import pathlib,struct,os,hashlib
p=pathlib.Path('.git/index');data=p.read_bytes()
assert data[:4]==b'DIRC'
version,count=struct.unpack_from('>II',data,4)
assert version in (2,3) and count==1
assert hashlib.sha1(data[:-20]).digest()==data[-20:]
fields=struct.unpack_from('>10I',data,12)
st=os.stat('fresh')
wanted=(st.st_ctime_ns//10**9,st.st_ctime_ns%10**9,st.st_mtime_ns//10**9,st.st_mtime_ns%10**9,st.st_dev,st.st_ino,0o100644,st.st_uid,st.st_gid,st.st_size)
wanted=tuple(v&0xffffffff for v in wanted)
assert fields==wanted,(fields,wanted)
assert data[52:72].hex()=='e69de29bb2d1d6434b8b29ae775ad8c2e48c5391'
flags=struct.unpack_from('>H',data,72)[0]
assert flags==5 and data[74:80]==b'fresh\0'
assert st.st_size==0 and not pathlib.Path('.git/index.lock').exists()
assert sorted(x.name for x in pathlib.Path('.git').iterdir())==['HEAD','config','index','info','objects','refs']
print('index-stat-fields-and-checksum-verified')
STATCHECK
  printf 'after-add\n'
  git ls-files --stage | while IFS= read -r line; do printf '%s\n' "${line/$'\t'/ }"; done
  git update-index --force-remove -- fresh
  printf 'after-remove\n'
  git ls-files --stage | while IFS= read -r line; do printf '%s\n' "${line/$'\t'/ }"; done
fi

cases.purpose: Refresh an unchanged entry and compare mode/blob/stage/path with Git. Independently decode every stored stat field, verify it against os.stat of the private working file, verify SHA-1 trailer and lock/temp cleanup. compare_tree is disabled because raw inode, timestamps and Git object storage differ inherently; those stat fields are explicitly checked against each side's independent filesystem observations.
cases.script:
mkdir -p .git/objects .git/refs/heads .git/info
printf 'ref: refs/heads/main\n' > .git/HEAD
printf '[core]\n\trepositoryformatversion = 0\n\tfilemode = true\n\tbare = false\n' > .git/config
: > fresh
if [[ $(type -t index) == builtin ]]; then
  printf '100644 e69de29bb2d1d6434b8b29ae775ad8c2e48c5391 0\tfresh\n' | index write .git/index
  index update-stat .git/index fresh
  index read .git/index
else
  printf '100644 e69de29bb2d1d6434b8b29ae775ad8c2e48c5391\tfresh\n' | git update-index --index-info
  blob=$(printf '' | git hash-object -w --stdin)
  [[ $blob == e69de29bb2d1d6434b8b29ae775ad8c2e48c5391 ]]
  git update-index --refresh
  git ls-files --stage | while IFS= read -r line; do printf '%s\n' "${line/$'\t'/ }"; done
fi
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin python3 - <<'STATCHECK'
import pathlib,struct,os,hashlib
p=pathlib.Path('.git/index');data=p.read_bytes()
assert data[:4]==b'DIRC'
version,count=struct.unpack_from('>II',data,4)
assert version in (2,3) and count==1
assert hashlib.sha1(data[:-20]).digest()==data[-20:]
fields=struct.unpack_from('>10I',data,12)
st=os.stat('fresh')
wanted=(st.st_ctime_ns//10**9,st.st_ctime_ns%10**9,st.st_mtime_ns//10**9,st.st_mtime_ns%10**9,st.st_dev,st.st_ino,0o100644,st.st_uid,st.st_gid,st.st_size)
wanted=tuple(v&0xffffffff for v in wanted)
assert fields==wanted,(fields,wanted)
assert data[52:72].hex()=='e69de29bb2d1d6434b8b29ae775ad8c2e48c5391'
flags=struct.unpack_from('>H',data,72)[0]
assert flags==5 and data[74:80]==b'fresh\0'
assert st.st_size==0 and not pathlib.Path('.git/index.lock').exists()
assert sorted(x.name for x in pathlib.Path('.git').iterdir())==['HEAD','config','index','info','objects','refs']
print('index-stat-fields-and-checksum-verified')
STATCHECK

cases.purpose: Validate rollback and lock/temp cleanup when an atomic index replacement fails at different I/O stages.
Write the canonical empty v2 index and read it back; compare the complete binary header/count/SHA-1 trailer with an independently encoded Git-format contract, including no lock/temp residue.
cases.script:
printf '' | index write empty.index
index read empty.index
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin python3 - <<'EMPTY'
import pathlib,sys
assert sorted(p.name for p in pathlib.Path('.').iterdir()) == ['empty.index']
sys.stdout.buffer.write(pathlib.Path('empty.index').read_bytes())
EMPTY

cases.purpose: Read a valid Git v2 index constructed independently from the published binary format, covering stdout/list/array APIs without candidate writer dependence.
cases.script:
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin python3 - <<'ENCODE'
import struct,hashlib,pathlib
entry=struct.pack('>10I',0,0,0,0,0,0,0o100644,0,0,0)+bytes.fromhex('11'*20)+struct.pack('>H',5)+b'alpha\0'
entry+=b'\0'*((-len(entry))%8)
data=b'DIRC'+struct.pack('>II',2,1)+entry
pathlib.Path('sample.index').write_bytes(data+hashlib.sha1(data).digest())
ENCODE
index read sample.index
index list sample.index
index read sample.index -V rows
printf '%s\n' "${rows[@]}"
